verdicts.reason: Both just place the original block onto the tall canvas without reworking it. In both, the red T stem stops in mid-air instead of bleeding off the bottom and top as it does in the original. The headline also stays small, filling only about a third of the frame. A is centred vertically and keeps the right-edge bleed of the T bar, so it is balanced, though about 200px of dead blue sits above and below. B pushes everything into the top half and leaves the bottom ~330px empty, and its T bar ends short of the right edge, so 'NOW!' sits cramped against the bar's end. B looks more lopsided and unfinished.
